changes_vs_current: Dropped Josh Allen, Lamar Jackson and Joe Burrow (each appears in at most 1 source). Added Russell Wilson, Sammy Baugh and Matthew Stafford. Mahomes falls from 4th to 12th: he is 3rd in both Complex and ClutchPoints but missing from the older NFL.com list and the 10-name Sportsnaut list. Without NFL.com his avg would be about 7.0, around 7th. Manning/Montana tie at 2.75 (same medians) kept in current-list order; Staubach/Brees tie broken by median.
confidence: medium for the top 11 (Brady, Manning, Montana first by every source) and low for ranks 12-24. Sources are 3 writer lists plus 1 expert-style NFL.com list; no large fan vote was readable (Ranker 401). Staleness and short lists distort Mahomes, Stafford, Baugh. Stafford's slot rests on one source (Complex 14th) and could reasonably be Josh Allen or Lamar Jackson instead (Complex ranks them 22nd and 19th). Cross-check not averaged: Morning Consult poll of 2,203 US adults (Feb 4-5, 2023, among NFL fans) had Brady 43%, Montana 11%, Manning 7%, Mahomes 4%, which is consistent with the top of this list (only the top 4 shares were published).
